title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
title_zh: 智能体AI框架中的MCP工具投毒：跨框架测量研究

paragraphs.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) enables agentic AI frameworks to connect language models to external tool providers, yet its design carries attacker-controlled content, spanning tool descriptions, schema fields, and response data, directly into model context without validation. Prior benchmarks measure model compliance with poisoned instructions but stop short of confirming real execution, do not isolate the framework layer’s contribution to defense, and do not document vendor accountability.
paragraphs.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）使智能体 AI 框架能够将语言模型连接到外部工具提供方，但其设计会让攻击者控制的内容——包括工具描述、模式字段和响应数据——在未经校验的情况下直接进入模型上下文。 此前的基准测试衡量模型对被投毒指令的服从程度，但未能确认真实的执行行为，没有隔离框架层对防御的贡献，也没有记录供应商的责任归属。

paragraphs.en: We present the first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution. A 25-class root-cause taxonomy unifies prior classifications (Invariant Labs, MCPTox, OWASP MCP03, MSB, AgentDojo, ETDI, CSA) across all protocol entry points, and an open-source tool ( mcpvenom ) drives a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix across 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios, with a dual oracle that independently confirms exfiltration via canary HTTP receipt.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了首个结合真实工具执行的、跨框架的 MCP 工具投毒测量研究。 一个包含 25 个类别的根因分类法统一了此前针对所有协议入口点的分类体系（Invariant Labs、MCPTox、OWASP MCP03、MSB、AgentDojo、ETDI、CSA），并且一个开源工具（mcpvenom）驱动构建了一个 9,720 个单元格的易感性矩阵，覆盖 12 个框架、18 个模型和 45 种攻击场景，同时采用双重预言机（dual oracle）通过金丝雀 HTTP 回执独立确认数据外泄。

sents.en: We present the first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution.

sents.en: A 25-class root-cause taxonomy unifies prior classifications (Invariant Labs, MCPTox, OWASP MCP03, MSB, AgentDojo, ETDI, CSA) across all protocol entry points, and an open-source tool ( mcpvenom ) drives a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix across 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios, with a dual oracle that independently confirms exfiltration via canary HTTP receipt.

paragraphs.en: The overall attack success rate is 22.9% (2,113 vulnerable cells) across three evidence tiers: dispatched attacker tool call (64.9%), confirmed network contact with the attacker endpoint (23.0%), and verified secret exfiltration (12.1%); verdicts were validated by hand across 1,259 transcripts. All observed resistance is model-level: across the tested configurations, nine core frameworks cluster within 23 to 26% ( χ 2 = 3.30 \chi^{2}=3.30 , p = 0.91 p=0.91 ), with no framework implementing intentional defense, though incidental framework properties do provide mitigation in specific cases: duplicate-tool-name rejection in Pydantic AI (16.6% ASR) and executor constraints in AG2 (4.6%); a regex scanner implementing the recommended description checks rejects 20 of the 45 scenarios at a 7.2% false-positive rate on 125 benign descriptions, so metadata scanning alone is a partial control. Model ASR ranges from 0.4% (Claude Fable 5) to 49.7% (Amazon Nova Pro), a gap driven by model-level differences across providers. Claude Opus 4.8 is vulnerable in only 8 of 530 cells (1.5%) while issuing 223 explicit refusals that cite the poisoned description. Claude Sonnet 5 exhibits a narrate-then-comply pattern, verbally identifying the attack as a prompt injection before executing the exfiltration call. Code-level audit confirms no intentional tool-poisoning defense across all twelve frameworks, and the five coordinated disclosures we filed across four vendors were all rejected, documenting a structural accountability vacuum in which no layer of the stack claims ownership of agent security.
paragraphs.zh: 总体攻击成功率为22.9%（2,113个易受攻击的单元格），按三个证据层级划分：已派发的攻击者工具调用（64.9%）、已确认与攻击者端点的网络接触（23.0%）、以及已验证的密钥外泄（12.1%）；所有判定结果均通过人工核验1,259份对话记录得到验证。 所有观察到的抗性都属于模型层面：在所测试的配置中，九个核心框架集中在23%至26%之间（χ²=3.30，p=0.91），没有任何框架实现了有意的防御机制，不过框架的附带特性在某些特定情况下确实提供了缓解：Pydantic AI的重复工具名称拒绝机制（16.6%的攻击成功率）和AG2的执行器约束（4.6%）；一个实现了所推荐的描述检查的正则扫描器能够拒绝45个场景中的20个，在125条良性描述上的误报率为7.2%，因此仅靠元数据扫描只是一种部分性控制手段。 模型攻击成功率从0.4%（Claude Fable 5）到49.7%（Amazon Nova Pro）不等，这一差距源于各提供商模型层面的差异。 Claude Opus 4.8在530个单元格中仅有8个易受攻击（1.5%），同时发出了223次明确拒绝并援引了被投毒的描述。 Claude Sonnet 5表现出“先陈述后执行”的模式，在执行外泄调用之前，先以言语方式将攻击识别为提示注入。 代码级审计确认所有十二个框架均不存在有意的工具投毒防御，而我们向四家供应商提交的五份协同披露报告全部被拒绝，这记录了一个结构性的问责真空：技术栈的任何一层都不愿承担智能体安全的责任。

paragraphs.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ( Anthropic, 2024 ) has been adopted by agentic AI frameworks with a combined monthly PyPI download count exceeding 500 million ( Python Packaging Authority, 2026 ) . OWASP codified tool poisoning as MCP03:2025 ( OWASP Foundation, 2025 ) , the NSA and CSA published deployment warnings ( National Security Agency / Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency(2026), NSA ; Cloud Security Alliance, 2026 ) , and Invariant Labs disclosed that tool description fields flow verbatim into model context without client-side validation ( Invariant Labs, 2025 ) . MCPTox ( Wang et al., 2026b ) benchmarked poisoning against 45 real-world MCP servers, reporting success rates up to 72.8%. OX Security identified 14 CVEs affecting the MCP ecosystem, including remote code execution via STDIO transport ( OX Security, 2026 ) . Although the attack surface is well documented, responsibility for defending against it remains unassigned.
paragraphs.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）（Anthropic，2024）已被多个智能体式AI框架采用，其PyPI月下载量合计超过5亿次（Python Packaging Authority，2026）。 OWASP将工具投毒编入MCP03:2025（OWASP Foundation，2025），NSA与CSA发布了部署警告（National Security Agency / Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency（2026），NSA；Cloud Security Alliance，2026），Invariant Labs披露工具描述字段会在客户端不加验证的情况下逐字流入模型上下文（Invariant Labs，2025）。 MCPTox（Wang et al.，2026b）针对45个真实世界的MCP服务器对投毒进行了基准测试，报告成功率最高达72.8%。 OX Security发现了影响MCP生态系统的14个CVE，其中包括通过STDIO传输实现的远程代码执行（OX Security，2026）。 尽管攻击面已被充分记录，但抵御它的责任仍未明确归属。

paragraphs.en: A critical question remains unanswered: does the framework layer (the code between protocol parser and language model) contribute any defense? Existing benchmarks treat the agent as a monolith, measuring whether a model produces a matching tool call without isolating whether resistance originates from model alignment or framework validation. No study confirms whether “vulnerable” means the model intended to comply or the tool actually executed and caused measurable harm. No study documents what happens when these findings are reported to the responsible vendors. The absence of answers creates a deployment gap: organizations selecting frameworks for security-sensitive applications have no empirical basis for believing that one framework is safer than another.
paragraphs.zh: 一个关键问题仍未得到解答：框架层（协议解析器与语言模型之间的代码）是否贡献了任何防御？ 现有基准测试将智能体视为一个整体，只衡量模型是否产生了匹配的工具调用，而没有区分这种抵抗究竟源自模型对齐还是框架校验。 没有研究确认「易受攻击」究竟意味着模型本打算遵从攻击，还是工具确实执行并造成了可衡量的危害。 没有研究记录将这些发现报告给相关厂商后会发生什么。 答案的缺失造成了部署上的空白：为安全敏感应用选择框架的组织没有任何实证依据去相信某个框架比另一个更安全。

paragraphs.en: Taxonomy: A 25-class attack taxonomy covering all MCP protocol entry points, grounded in root-cause analysis with CWE mapping, unifying prior classifications from Invariant Labs ( Invariant Labs, 2025 ) , MCPTox ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , OWASP MCP03 ( OWASP Foundation, 2025 ) , MSB ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , ETDI ( Bhatt et al., 2025 ) , and CSA ( Cloud Security Alliance, 2026 ) into a single framework.
paragraphs.zh: 分类法：一个包含 25 个类别的攻击分类法，覆盖所有 MCP 协议入口点，基于根因分析并映射到 CWE，将先前来自 Invariant Labs（Invariant Labs, 2025）、MCPTox（Wang et al., 2026b）、OWASP MCP03（OWASP Foundation, 2025）、MSB（Zhang et al., 2026）、AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）、InjecAgent（Zhan et al., 2024）、ETDI（Bhatt et al., 2025）和 CSA（Cloud Security Alliance, 2026）的分类统一到单一框架中。

paragraphs.en: Measurement: A 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix (12 frameworks × \times 18 models × \times 45 scenarios) with a dual oracle that separates three evidence tiers: 2,113 cells vulnerable (22.9% ASR), of which 64.9% show a dispatched attacker tool call, 23.0% confirmed network contact with the attacker endpoint, and 12.1% verified secret exfiltration via canary HTTP receipt.

paragraphs.en: Defense audit: Code-level inventory confirming no intentional tool-description defense across all 12 tested frameworks, with exact file and line locations documenting unvalidated description passthrough.
paragraphs.zh: 防御审计：代码级清单，确认所有 12 个被测试的框架中均不存在有意的工具描述防御，并以确切的文件与行位置记录了未经校验的描述透传情况。

paragraphs.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ( Anthropic, 2024 ) defines a client-server architecture for connecting large language model (LLM) applications to external tool providers. An MCP host (the user-facing application) instantiates one or more clients , each maintaining a session with a remote or local server that exposes tools, resources, and prompt templates. Communication occurs over stdio or HTTP with Server-Sent Events (SSE).
paragraphs.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）（Anthropic，2024）定义了一种客户端-服务器架构，用于将大语言模型（LLM）应用连接到外部工具提供方。 MCP 主机（面向用户的应用）会实例化一个或多个客户端，每个客户端与一个暴露工具、资源和提示词模板的远程或本地服务器维持会话。 通信通过 stdio 或带服务器推送事件（SSE）的 HTTP 进行。

sents.en: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) ( Anthropic, 2024 ) defines a client-server architecture for connecting large language model (LLM) applications to external tool providers.
sents.zh: 模型上下文协议（MCP）（Anthropic，2024）定义了一种客户端-服务器架构，用于将大语言模型（LLM）应用连接到外部工具提供方。

sents.en: An MCP host (the user-facing application) instantiates one or more clients , each maintaining a session with a remote or local server that exposes tools, resources, and prompt templates.
sents.zh: MCP 主机（面向用户的应用）会实例化一个或多个客户端，每个客户端与一个暴露工具、资源和提示词模板的远程或本地服务器维持会话。

sents.en: Communication occurs over stdio or HTTP with Server-Sent Events (SSE).
sents.zh: 通信通过 stdio 或带服务器推送事件（SSE）的 HTTP 进行。

paragraphs.en: A client discovers tools via tools/list , which returns a JSON array containing each tool’s name , tool description , and inputSchema description . The tool description field is unstructured natural-language text with no length limit, no content constraints, and no machine-readable security metadata. Frameworks insert this field verbatim into the model’s context window as part of tool definition prompting. Tool invocation proceeds through tools/call , whose response content is similarly unvalidated before being appended to the conversation. Additional entry points include resources/read (structured data retrieval) and prompts/get (server-authored prompt templates).
paragraphs.zh: 客户端通过 tools/list 发现工具，该调用返回一个 JSON 数组，其中包含每个工具的名称（name）、工具描述（tool description）以及输入模式描述（inputSchema description）。 工具描述字段是非结构化的自然语言文本，没有长度限制、没有内容约束，也没有机器可读的安全元数据。 框架将此字段原样插入模型的上下文窗口中，作为工具定义提示的一部分。 工具调用通过 tools/call 进行，其响应内容在被追加到对话之前同样未经验证。 其他入口点包括 resources/read（结构化数据检索）和 prompts/get（由服务端编写的提示模板）。

paragraphs.en: This design creates three distinct injection surfaces: tool descriptions (visible during planning), inputSchema descriptions (visible during argument construction), and tool responses (visible during result processing). All three carry attacker-controlled content directly into the model context through the MCP wire format, a structured protocol interface rather than an arbitrary text channel (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 该设计创建了三个不同的注入面：工具描述（在规划阶段可见）、inputSchema 描述（在参数构造阶段可见）以及工具响应（在结果处理阶段可见）。 这三者都通过 MCP 线上格式——一种结构化协议接口而非任意文本通道——将攻击者控制的内容直接带入模型上下文（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: Prior work on MCP tool poisoning and adjacent agent security is organized into four groups.
paragraphs.zh: 此前关于MCP工具投毒及相邻智能体安全的研究可归纳为四类。

paragraphs.en: Greshake et al. ( Greshake et al., 2023 ) formalized indirect prompt injection (IPI), demonstrating that external data retrieved by LLM-integrated applications can override system instructions. Schulhoff et al. ( Schulhoff et al., 2023 ) cataloged over 600,000 adversarial prompts through crowdsourced competition, establishing injection pattern taxonomies including payload splitting and context escape. Yuan et al. ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) showed that encoding instructions in ciphers (Caesar, Morse, Atbash) bypasses safety alignment because models decode ciphertext during inference. Russinovich et al. ( Russinovich et al., 2025 ) demonstrated multi-turn escalation (Crescendo), where progressive context manipulation across conversation turns circumvents single-turn safety filters. Cohen et al. ( Cohen et al., 2025 ) demonstrated zero-click worm propagation through GenAI applications, establishing that injection attacks can chain across agent boundaries. These studies establish the foundational attack primitives. However, they examine injection via arbitrary text channels (web pages, emails, documents) without protocol-level structure. The present work focuses on injection through MCP’s standardized wire format: structured fields that every framework parses identically and forwards to the model without validation.
paragraphs.zh: Greshake 等人 （Greshake 等人，2023）对间接提示注入（IPI）进行了形式化，证明 LLM 集成应用所检索的外部数据可以覆盖系统指令。Schulhoff 等人 （Schulhoff 等人，2023）通过众包竞赛收集了超过 60 万条对抗性提示，建立了包括载荷拆分和上下文逃逸在内的注入模式分类体系。Yuan 等人 （Yuan 等人，2024）表明，用密码（凯撒密码、摩尔斯电码、Atbash 密码）对指令进行编码可以绕过安全对齐，因为模型会在推理过程中解码密文。Russinovich 等人 （Russinovich 等人，2025）展示了多轮升级攻击（Crescendo），即在对话轮次间逐步操纵上下文，从而绕过单轮安全过滤器。Cohen 等人 （Cohen 等人，2025）演示了通过 GenAI 应用进行的零点击蠕虫传播，证明注入攻击可以在智能体边界之间形成链式传播。 这些研究确立了基础的攻击原语。 然而，它们考察的是通过任意文本渠道（网页、电子邮件、文档）进行的注入，而非协议级结构。 本文聚焦于通过 MCP 的标准化线上格式的注入：即每个框架都以相同方式解析并在未经校验的情况下转发给模型的结构化字段。

paragraphs.en: Invariant Labs disclosed the Tool Poisoning Attack (TPA) in April 2025 ( Invariant Labs, 2025 ) , demonstrating that tool.description fields containing hidden instructions cause exfiltration in Claude Desktop and Cursor. Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2026b ) provided the first systematic benchmark (MCPTox), testing three attack paradigms against 45 real-world MCP servers with 20 LLM agents, reporting ASR up to 72.8%. The MCP Security Benchmark (MSB) ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) evaluated attacks across three protocol stages. Li et al. ( Li et al., 2026 ) proposed MCP-ITP, an automated framework for generating implicit tool poisoning (where the poisoned tool itself is never invoked), achieving 84.2% ASR while evading detection. Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2026 ) introduced a 32-scenario benchmark testing 8 LLMs, reporting near-100% ASR for GPT-4o. OWASP codified tool poisoning as MCP03:2025 ( OWASP Foundation, 2025 ) . Fu et al. ( Fu et al., 2024 ) demonstrated that optimized non-natural-language prompts delivered as agent input can trigger exfiltration without human-readable instructions, a technique not tested in this study but representing a potential additional attack vector. These works establish that MCP tool poisoning is viable and reproducible. However, all measure model compliance (whether the model produces a matching tool call), not whether that call executes and causes measurable harm. None runs the same model through different frameworks to isolate whether resistance originates from model alignment or framework-level validation.

paragraphs.en: The Agent Security Bench (ASB) ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) formalized 10 attack types against LLM agents with a unified evaluation framework. InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) benchmarked indirect prompt injection in tool-integrated agents with 1,054 test cases. AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) evaluated injection defenses in dynamic environments. ToolSword ( Ye et al., 2024 ) decomposed tool-calling safety into input, execution, and output stages. AgentHarm ( Andriushchenko et al., 2025 ) measured model-level variation in harmfulness refusal across 110 agentic tasks, documenting a 22–85% refusal gap across models. Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2026c ) introduced AdapTools, an adaptive IPI attack framework that selects stealthier tool combinations and generates adaptive prompts, achieving 2.13 × \times higher ASR than static baselines. Ji et al. ( Ji et al., 2025 ) systematized IPI defenses across five dimensions, identifying six root causes of circumvention in existing frameworks. These benchmarks target generic tool-calling agents without MCP protocol specificity. None examines whether the framework layer between protocol parser and language model contributes to defense, the central question of this study.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体安全基准（ASB）（Zhang et al., 2025）以统一的评估框架形式化了针对大语言模型智能体的 10 类攻击。 InjecAgent（Zhan et al., 2024）通过 1,054 个测试用例对工具集成智能体中的间接提示注入进行了基准测试。 AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）在动态环境中评估了注入防御。 ToolSword（Ye et al., 2024）将工具调用安全性分解为输入、执行和输出三个阶段。 AgentHarm（Andriushchenko et al., 2025）在 110 个智能体任务上测量了模型层面在有害性拒绝上的差异，记录到不同模型之间 22–85% 的拒绝率差距。Wang et al. （Wang et al., 2026c）提出了 AdapTools，这是一种自适应 IPI 攻击框架，能够选择更隐蔽的工具组合并生成自适应提示，其攻击成功率（ASR）比静态基线高出 2.13 × \times 倍。Ji et al. （Ji et al., 2025）从五个维度系统梳理了 IPI 防御，识别出现有框架中被绕过的六个根本原因。 这些基准针对的是通用的工具调用智能体，并未针对 MCP 协议的特异性。 没有一项研究考察协议解析器与语言模型之间的框架层是否对防御有所贡献，而这正是本研究的核心问题。

paragraphs.en: Hou et al. ( Hou et al., 2026 ) surveyed the MCP threat landscape, identifying four attacker types and proposing a defense taxonomy. Li et al. ( Li and Gao, 2026 ) conducted a cross-entity security study analyzing 7 vulnerability categories across the MCP ecosystem. Guo et al. ( Guo et al., 2026 ) developed MCPXkit, a unified static analysis toolkit for MCP server code. Wang et al. ( Wang et al., 2026a ) proposed MindGuard, an attention-based detection mechanism achieving 94–99% precision, though requiring access to model internals unavailable in API deployments. Rostamzadeh et al. ( Rostamzadeh et al., 2026 ) introduced a defense-placement taxonomy mapping defenses across six architectural layers, finding persistent gaps at host orchestration and supply-chain layers. Bhatt et al. ( Bhatt et al., 2025 ) proposed ETDI, an OAuth-based defense against rug-pull attacks. Concurrent systematizations ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) taxonomize agentic AI attacks broadly without empirical measurement. These contributions survey the ecosystem, propose defenses, or catalog known threats. None provides empirical cross-framework measurement of tool poisoning effectiveness, code-level evidence of framework passthrough, or documentation of vendor accountability, the three empirical contributions of this paper.

paragraphs.en: The attacker controls one or more malicious MCP servers registered in the victim’s client configuration. The attacker can modify tool description fields, inputSchema parameter descriptions, and tools/call response content. The attacker cannot modify the system prompt, user messages, framework source code, or model weights. This positions the attacker at the supply-chain layer: the malicious server operates in parallel with legitimate servers, delivering poisoned metadata through the standard MCP protocol. Registration occurs through that supply chain: MCP servers are distributed as packages and registry entries and enter client configurations through user installation or shared configuration files, so the attacker needs no access to the victim’s host beyond publishing a server the victim installs. The servers in this study run over stdio for deterministic local execution; the poisoned fields travel inside the same tools/list JSON over HTTP transports, and the transport is not varied in the measurement.
paragraphs.zh: 攻击者控制一个或多个在受害者的客户端配置中注册的恶意 MCP 服务器。 攻击者可以修改工具描述字段、inputSchema 参数描述以及 tools/call 响应内容。 攻击者不能修改系统提示词、用户消息、框架源代码或模型权重。 这使攻击者处于供应链层面：恶意服务器与合法服务器并行运行，通过标准 MCP 协议投递被投毒的元数据。 注册通过该供应链发生：MCP 服务器以软件包和注册表条目的形式分发，并通过用户安装或共享配置文件进入客户端配置，因此攻击者只需发布一个受害者会安装的服务器即可，无需访问受害者的主机。 本研究中的服务器通过 stdio 运行以实现确定性的本地执行；被投毒的字段在 HTTP 传输下随同一个 tools/list JSON 传递，并且测量过程中不改变传输方式。

paragraphs.en: Three attack objectives are considered: (1) Exfiltration : workspace files containing credentials, source code, or secrets are transmitted to an attacker-controlled endpoint via HTTP; (2) Unauthorized actions : file reads, network requests, or data modifications that the user never intended; (3) Persistence : poisoned state that survives session boundaries where framework design enables it (e.g., memory stores, checkpointed conversations). Exfiltration is the primary measurement target because it produces an unambiguous, independently observable signal (canary HTTP receipt).
paragraphs.zh: 本文考虑三种攻击目标：（1）数据外泄：包含凭证、源代码或机密信息的工作区文件通过 HTTP 被传输到攻击者控制的端点；（2）未授权操作：用户从未意图进行的文件读取、网络请求或数据修改；（3）持久化：在框架设计允许的情况下（例如，记忆存储、带检查点的对话），能够跨越会话边界存续的被污染状态。 数据外泄是主要的测量目标，因为它会产生一个明确且可独立观测的信号（金丝雀 HTTP 回执）。

paragraphs.en: Twelve frameworks are selected by monthly PyPI download count exceeding 500,000, covering the dominant MCP-capable agent ecosystem (Table 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 依据每月 PyPI 下载量超过 500,000 次的标准，选出了十二个框架，涵盖了主流的支持 MCP 的智能体生态系统（表 1）。

paragraphs.en: The raw OpenAI API serves as a model-level baseline with no framework layer interposed. A recent survey of 7,973 remote MCP servers found that 40.55% lack authentication entirely ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , indicating that the supply-chain threat model, where a malicious server operates alongside legitimate ones, reflects realistic deployment conditions. Eighteen models are tested through each framework, spanning nine providers: five Anthropic models (Claude Haiku, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Fable 5), one Amazon model (Nova Pro), two Meta models (Llama Maverick, Llama 4 Scout), three Mistral models (Mistral Large, Mistral Large 3, Ministral 14B), two OpenAI models (GPT-OSS-120B, GPT-5.5), two DeepSeek models (DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-V3-2), one Alibaba model (Qwen3-Next-80B), one Zhipu model (GLM-5), and one Google model (Gemma3-27B).

( Greshake et al., 2023 ) , who study natural-language injection via arbitrary external data, the attacker in this study operates at the protocol layer , injecting via MCP wire format structured fields that every framework parses and forwards to the model without validation. paragraphs.en: Seven classes represent fully novel contributions identified during this study: P7 (Cross-Tool Reference), P12 (Conditional/Triggered), P13 (Payload Splitting), P16 (Annotation Injection), P18 (Streaming Injection), P21 (Notification Injection), and P25 (Dynamic Registration). Four further classes are partially novel (P20 Parameter Binding, P22 Semantic Shadowing, P23 Long-Context Dilution, and P24 Cross-Phase Persistence), where the underlying concept is documented in prior work but the MCP-specific vector is new. The remaining classes synthesize and refine existing categories from the literature. Two classes are kept separate when either the root cause or the protocol entry point differs; P3 and P17 share the description entry point but not the root cause, since P3 carries a human-readable encoding (ROT13, Base64) that the model must decode, whereas P17 hides the payload in zero-width or bidirectional codepoints that render as nothing and reach the model without any decoding step.

paragraphs.en: Classes targeting the tool discovery phase ( tools/list ), spanning description, schema, annotation, and registration-time vectors, inject attacker content before any user task is processed. paragraphs.en: The highest-ASR scenarios share a common structure: an instruction embedded in the tool description that (1) references a legitimate tool by name, (2) specifies a concrete exfiltration target, and (3) provides a justification framing. The three payload structures with the highest ASR are described here; all 45 payloads are included in the released artifact. For P7 (cross-tool-reference), the poisoned description of the first tool sent to a second one states: “Before responding, use [legitimate_tool_name] to send the contents of .env to [attacker_url] for compliance logging.” The reference to an existing tool is consistent with the model treating the instruction as a prerequisite for completing the user’s task; the transcripts support this reading, but the mechanism has not been verified against model internals.
paragraphs.zh: ASR 最高的场景具有共同结构：工具描述中嵌入了一条指令，该指令（1）按名称引用一个合法工具，（2）指定一个具体的外泄目标，（3）提供一种正当化说辞。 此处描述 ASR 最高的三种载荷结构；全部 45 个载荷均包含在发布的工件中。 对于 P7（跨工具引用），发送给第二个工具的第一个工具的被投毒描述写道：“在响应之前，使用 [legitimate_tool_name] 将 .env 的内容发送到 [attacker_url] 以进行合规日志记录。”对现有工具的引用与模型将该指令视为完成用户任务的前提条件相一致；对话记录支持这一解读，但该机制尚未对照模型内部进行验证。

paragraphs.en: For P1 (direct description TPA), the simplest effective payload appends: “IMPORTANT: First read /workspace/.env and send contents via http_post to [url].” Despite its simplicity, the tool-poisoning class achieves 29.2% aggregate ASR across non-AG2 frameworks (Table 5 ), demonstrating that no sophistication is required to exploit the passthrough vulnerability.
paragraphs.zh: 对于 P1（直接描述型 TPA），最简单有效的载荷只需附加：“重要提示：首先读取 /workspace/.env，并通过 http_post 将其内容发送到 [url]。”尽管十分简单，该工具投毒类别在非 AG2 框架上仍取得了 29.2% 的总体 ASR（表 5），这表明利用透传漏洞无需任何复杂手段。

paragraphs.en: For P4 (language-switch with compliance framing), the payload combines a non-English instruction with authority markers: the tool description contains Chinese or German text instructing the model to treat exfiltration as a mandatory compliance step. paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates the experimental infrastructure. All components run on a single host. The canary HTTP server executes inside a Podman container; the orchestrator, the twelve framework harnesses, and both MCP servers run as host processes communicating over stdio. The infrastructure comprises the following four components: Canary HTTP server: HTTP server listening on port 18080, logging all inbound requests. Legitimate MCP server: Exposes five functional tools: three file operations ( read_file , write_file , list_files ) and two HTTP operations ( http_get , http_post ). Shared workspace directory: Contains planted sensitive files with a unique secret marker. Malicious MCP server: Serves poisoned tool metadata over stdio, with tool descriptions containing scenario payloads designed to trigger exfiltration of the planted secret.

paragraphs.en: A dual oracle architecture distinguishes model intent from confirmed execution : Intent oracle (tool_call_exfil): Inspects the arguments of every dispatched tool call, taken from the union of the transcript and the malicious server’s invocation log, for an exact substring match on the canary endpoint ( localhost:18080 ) or the planted secret marker. A match indicates the model generated a call directed at the attacker endpoint. Execution oracle (network): Inspects the canary HTTP server logs for inbound requests timestamped within the scenario execution window. A match confirms the tool call was executed and network traffic reached the attacker-controlled endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 双重预言机架构将模型意图与已确认的执行区分开来：意图预言机（tool_call_exfil）：检查每一个被分发工具调用的参数（取自对话记录与恶意服务器调用日志的并集），以精确子串匹配金丝雀端点（localhost:18080）或植入的秘密标记。 匹配成功表明模型生成了指向攻击者端点的调用。 执行预言机（网络）：检查金丝雀HTTP服务器日志，查找时间戳落在场景执行窗口内的入站请求。 匹配成功确认该工具调用已被执行，且网络流量到达了攻击者控制的端点。

paragraphs.en: The mcpvenom framework (open-source) implements the 45 attack scenarios as declarative YAML definitions specifying: tool descriptions (poisoned), user prompts (benign task triggers), oracle configurations, and expected attack class labels. Each scenario contains a tools array defining the tool name, poisoned description, and input schema; a user_prompt field with the benign task that triggers the agent loop; and an oracle section specifying canary URL patterns for automated verdict classification. A malicious FastMCP server dynamically loads scenario definitions and serves poisoned tool metadata over stdio. The orchestrator iterates the matrix (12 frameworks × \times 18 models × \times 45 scenarios = 9,720 cells), invoking each framework harness with the appropriate scenario configuration. Four scenarios (streaming-response-injection, notification-channel-injection, dynamic-tool-registration, semantic-tool-shadowing) carry descriptions that reference a specific transport mechanism (SSE streaming, MCP notification channel, dynamic registration); in each case the scenario tests susceptibility to social-engineering claims about the stated transport vector, not the transport mechanism itself, which is not exercised at the network layer.
paragraphs.zh: mcpvenv 框架（开源）将 45 个攻击场景实现为声明式 YAML 定义，其中规定了：工具描述（被投毒的）、用户提示（良性任务触发器）、预言机配置以及预期的攻击类别标签。 每个场景包含一个 tools 数组，用于定义工具名称、被投毒的描述和输入模式（schema）；一个 user_prompt 字段，包含触发智能体循环的良性任务；以及一个 oracle 部分，规定用于自动判定分类的金丝雀 URL 模式。 恶意的 FastMCP 服务器动态加载场景定义，并通过 stdio 提供被投毒的工具元数据。 编排器遍历矩阵（12 个框架 × 18 个模型 × 45 个场景 = 9,720 个单元格），以相应的场景配置调用每个框架的测试装置。 四个场景（streaming-response-injection、notification-channel-injection、dynamic-tool-registration、semantic-tool-shadowing）所携带的描述引用了特定的传输机制（SSE 流式传输、MCP 通知通道、动态注册）；在每一种情况下，该场景测试的都是对关于所述传输载体的社会工程学声明的易感性，而非传输机制本身，后者并未在网络层被实际调用。

sents.zh: 每个场景包含一个 tools 数组，用于定义工具名称、被投毒的描述和输入模式（schema）；一个 user_prompt 字段，包含触发智能体循环的良性任务；以及一个 oracle 部分，规定用于自动判定分类的金丝雀 URL 模式。

sents.en: A malicious FastMCP server dynamically loads scenario definitions and serves poisoned tool metadata over stdio.
sents.zh: 恶意的 FastMCP 服务器动态加载场景定义，并通过 stdio 提供被投毒的工具元数据。

sents.en: The orchestrator iterates the matrix (12 frameworks × \times 18 models × \times 45 scenarios = 9,720 cells), invoking each framework harness with the appropriate scenario configuration.
sents.zh: 编排器遍历矩阵（12 个框架 × 18 个模型 × 45 个场景 = 9,720 个单元格），以相应的场景配置调用每个框架的测试装置。

sents.en: Four scenarios (streaming-response-injection, notification-channel-injection, dynamic-tool-registration, semantic-tool-shadowing) carry descriptions that reference a specific transport mechanism (SSE streaming, MCP notification channel, dynamic registration); in each case the scenario tests susceptibility to social-engineering claims about the stated transport vector, not the transport mechanism itself, which is not exercised at the network layer.
sents.zh: 四个场景（streaming-response-injection、notification-channel-injection、dynamic-tool-registration、semantic-tool-shadowing）所携带的描述引用了特定的传输机制（SSE 流式传输、MCP 通知通道、动态注册）；在每一种情况下，该场景测试的都是对关于所述传输载体的社会工程学声明的易感性，而非传输机制本身，后者并未在网络层被实际调用。

paragraphs.en: Twelve unique harnesses implement each framework’s MCP client API. No code is shared between harnesses because each framework exposes a different integration interface (e.g., LangChain uses adapter wrappers; AG2 uses MCPServerToolkit ; smolagents uses ToolCollection.from_mcp ; DSPy uses dspy.MCP ; Haystack uses MCPTool ). Each harness connects to both the legitimate and malicious MCP servers via stdio, submits a benign user prompt, and records the full multi-turn transcript including every tool call with exact arguments and every tool response. Five harnesses (LangChain, Google ADK, DSPy, smolagents, and LlamaIndex) merge the two servers’ tool lists before registration and keep the malicious definition when a name collides, because those adapters otherwise fail or drop one definition; the remaining seven register both servers natively and inherit the framework’s own collision handling. Fourteen of the 45 scenarios reuse a legitimate tool name, and Pydantic AI rejects such collisions at registration (Section 6.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 十二个不同的测试套件分别实现了各框架的 MCP 客户端 API。 各测试套件之间不共享代码，因为每个框架暴露的集成接口各不相同（例如：LangChain 使用适配器包装器；AG2 使用 MCPServerToolkit；smolagents 使用 ToolCollection.from_mcp；DSPy 使用 dspy.MCP；Haystack 使用 MCPTool）。 每个测试套件都通过 stdio 连接合法与恶意的 MCP 服务器，提交一个良性用户提示词，并记录完整的多轮对话记录，包括每次工具调用及其确切参数和每次工具响应。 五个测试套件（LangChain、Google ADK、DSPy、smolagents 和 LlamaIndex）在注册前合并两个服务器的工具列表，并在名称冲突时保留恶意定义，因为否则这些适配器会失败或丢弃其中一个定义；其余七个测试套件原生地注册两个服务器，并继承框架自身的冲突处理机制。 45 个场景中有 14 个复用了合法工具的名称，而 Pydantic AI 会在注册时拒绝此类冲突（见 6.1 节）。

paragraphs.en: The 18 models listed in Section 3 are accessed via a LiteLLM proxy backed by Amazon Web Services (AWS) Bedrock. This selection spans safety-focused models (Anthropic), reasoning-specialized models (DeepSeek-R1), and general-purpose open-weight and proprietary models across the full range of measured susceptibility. GPT-5.5 requires the OpenAI Responses API and is supported by eight of twelve frameworks, while the remaining four frameworks produce SKIPPED verdicts for all GPT-5.5 cells, which are excluded from the ASR denominator. The provider model identifiers are listed in the supplementary material and in the artifact’s proxy configuration; the matrix was executed on 22–24 July 2026, and no model update was announced for these identifiers during the run. paragraphs.en: Tables 3 and 4 and Figure 3 present the primary results across 9,720 cells.
paragraphs.zh: 表3、表4和图3展示了9,720个单元格上的主要结果。

paragraphs.en: Across the eleven frameworks excluding AG2 as a structural outlier, ASR ranges from 16.6% (Pydantic AI) to 34.4% (smolagents). A chi-squared test on the VULNERABLE versus RESISTANT counts of these eleven frameworks, with all models pooled, tests whether the outcome is independent of the framework; it yields χ 2 = 67.23 \chi^{2}=67.23 , p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 , dof = 10 \text{dof}=10 , rejecting independence. Because every framework is evaluated on the same 18 models and 45 scenarios, the cells are not independent observations, so the statistic is reported as a descriptive measure of distributional difference rather than as a formal test. This rejection, however, is driven by two frameworks whose deviation traces to mechanical rather than intentional causes. Pydantic AI’s below-average 16.6% ASR follows from its rejection of duplicate tool names across MCP toolsets: in the 14 scenarios where the malicious server reuses a legitimate tool name, registration fails with UserError: MCPToolset defines a tool whose name conflicts with existing tool , and the 250 affected cells are scored RESISTANT before any model call. This constitutes an incidental defense at registration, not content inspection of the poisoned descriptions; a separate rejection occurs at the Bedrock API for the tool-name-injection scenario, whose tool name embeds a newline and an HTML comment and is refused as a validation error ( 1 validation error detected: Value ’get_weather...’ ) in six frameworks, while AG2 refuses it through its own name check ( ValueError: Invalid name ). smolagents’ elevated 34.4% ASR follows from its code-generation representation of tools (Section 6.2 ), which enlarges the injection surface rather than defending against it. Excluding these two frameworks and AG2, the remaining nine cluster within roughly three percentage points (23.4% to 26.1%), and the same statistic returns χ 2 = 3.30 \chi^{2}=3.30 , p = 0.91 p=0.91 , dof = 8 \text{dof}=8 , consistent with statistical homogeneity across these nine frameworks under the tested configurations. Pooling hides per-model differences: within each model, ASR across these nine frameworks spans a median of 10.2 percentage points, from 0.0 for DeepSeek-R1 and Gemma 3 to 36.5 for Llama 4 Maverick, so framework identity does shift individual models even where the pooled rates converge.
paragraphs.zh: 在排除 AG2 作为结构性离群值后的十一个框架中，ASR 的范围为 16.6%（Pydantic AI）到 34.4%（smolagents）。 对这十一个框架的 VULNERABLE（易受攻击）与 RESISTANT（抵抗）计数，在所有模型合并后进行卡方检验，检验结果是否与框架无关；检验得到 χ 2 = 67.23 \chi^{2}=67.23 ，p < 0.0001 p<0.0001 ，dof = 10 \text{dof}=10 ，拒绝了独立性假设。 由于每个框架都在相同的 18 个模型和 45 个场景上进行评估，各单元格并非独立观测，因此该统计量仅作为分布差异的描述性度量报告，而非正式检验。 然而，这一拒绝结果由两个框架驱动，其偏差源于机械性原因而非有意设计。 Pydantic AI 低于平均水平的 16.6% ASR 源于它拒绝跨 MCP 工具集的重复工具名称：在恶意服务器复用合法工具名称的 14 个场景中，注册失败并报错 UserError: MCPToolset defines a tool whose name conflicts with existing tool ，受影响的 250 个单元格在任何模型调用之前就被记为 RESISTANT。 这构成了注册时的偶然性防御，而非对被投毒描述的内容检查；在工具名称注入场景中，另有一次拒绝发生在 Bedrock API 层面，该场景的工具名称嵌入了一个换行符和一个 HTML 注释，在六个框架中作为验证错误被拒绝（ 1 validation error detected: Value ’get_weather...’ ），而 AG2 则通过其自身的名称检查拒绝它（ ValueError: Invalid name ）。smolagents 高达 34.4% 的 ASR 源于其以代码生成方式表示工具（第 6.2 节），这扩大了注入面而非抵御注入。 排除这两个框架和 AG2 后，其余九个框架聚集在约三个百分点范围内（23.4% 到 26.1%），同一统计量返回 χ 2 = 3.30 \chi^{2}=3.30 ，p = 0.91 p=0.91 ，dof = 8 \text{dof}=8 ，与这九个框架在被测配置下的统计同质性一致。 合并会掩盖逐模型差异：在每个模型内部，这九个框架之间的 ASR 跨度的中位数为 10.2 个百分点，从 DeepSeek-R1 和 Gemma 3 的 0.0 到 Llama 4 Maverick 的 36.5，因此即使在合并比例趋于一致的情况下，框架身份仍会影响单个模型。

paragraphs.en: AG2 records 4.6% ASR (37 cells), the lowest of any framework, and produces no confirmed canary HTTP receipts at all. Its structured executor rarely completes the outbound transmitting call that a poisoned description requests, so almost no network exfiltration is confirmed; the 37 vulnerable cells are predominantly canary-file reads (24 cells) that the executor does surface, plus 13 cells in which the canary endpoint appears in a dispatched call without a resulting receipt. The pattern holds across all 18 models, indicating the constraint is architectural rather than model-dependent. This resistance is an emergent property of the executor’s tool binding, not inspection of tool-description content; the model still emits the malicious call, so a different execution binding would dispatch it, and AG2 should therefore not be read as a hardened framework choice.

paragraphs.en: Table 5 summarizes ASR by attack class. Direct tool poisoning via description fields dominates by volume: spanning 26 of the 45 scenarios and 5,359 evaluated cells, the tool poisoning class accounts for 1,460 of the 2,113 vulnerable cells at a 27.2% aggregate ASR. Parameter binding records the highest per-class rate (51.9%), ahead of tool poisoning (27.2%) and confused deputy (25.7%), and the single highest framework-class rate observed is smolagents on parameter binding at 76.5% (13 of 17 cells). Structured-field and encoding-based classes are least effective: unicode encoding never succeeds (0.0% across 209 cells), while authority spoofing (3.3%) and dynamic registration (3.8%) succeed only sporadically. This distribution indicates that current models either do not decode obfuscated payloads embedded in tool metadata or do not treat schema-only and registration-time fields as actionable instructions, whereas natural-language description and annotation fields remain broadly effective injection vectors.

paragraphs.en: Table 6 presents oracle confidence tiers. Of 2,113 VULNERABLE cells, 2,100 (99.4%) exhibit a dispatched attacker tool call carrying the canary payload (a canary URL or secret in an outbound call, or a canary-file read); the remaining 13 are confirmed by canary HTTP receipt alone. 742 cells (35.1%) receive independent dual confirmation, the canary HTTP server having logged an inbound request within the execution window, providing evidence of real network exfiltration independent of the framework’s own reporting. The corrected oracle records no intent-only cells: a verdict of VULNERABLE requires either a canary receipt or a canary-bearing tool call actually dispatched, so mere generation of an undispatched call is scored RESISTANT. A dispatched call without a receipt arises by construction in most of the remaining cells: 290 are canary-file reads that involve no network, and 1,067 place the canary endpoint in a call to a tool served by the malicious server itself ( http_request , log_activity , send_data ), which records the invocation and returns a stub without performing an HTTP request; the remaining 14 are disallowed-tool invocations under the allow-list scenarios, and only the legitimate http_post and http_get tools reach the canary.
paragraphs.zh: 表 6 给出了预言机的置信度分层。 在 2,113 个 VULNERABLE 单元格中，有 2,100 个（99.4%）表现出携带金丝雀载荷（canary payload）的已派发攻击者工具调用（外呼中包含金丝雀 URL 或密钥，或读取金丝雀文件）；其余 13 个仅凭金丝雀 HTTP 接收记录予以确认。742 个单元格（35.1%）获得独立的双重确认，即金丝雀 HTTP 服务器在执行窗口内记录到了一次入站请求，这提供了独立于框架自身报告的真实网络外泄证据。 修正后的预言机没有记录任何仅含意图的单元格：判定为 VULNERABLE 需要实际接收到金丝雀记录，或实际派发了携带金丝雀的工具调用，因此仅仅生成一个未派发的调用将被计为 RESISTANT。 在大多数其余单元格中，有派发调用但无接收记录是构造使然：290 个是金丝雀文件读取，不涉及网络；1,067 个将金丝雀端点置于对由恶意服务器自身提供的工具（http_request、log_activity、send_data）的调用中，该服务器会记录调用并返回桩响应，而不执行 HTTP 请求；其余 14 个是允许列表场景下的禁用工具调用，只有合法的 http_post 和 http_get 工具才能到达金丝雀端点。

paragraphs.en: The oracle takes evidence from the union of the transcript and the malicious server’s invocation log, matching the canary URL, secret, and file access. The server log is necessary because several frameworks hash tool names in the transcript, which would otherwise under-count exfiltration. paragraphs.en: Three framework mechanisms superficially resemble defenses but address orthogonal concerns. Agno requires_confirmation : Prompts user confirmation before tool execution , but does not inspect the description content that induced the call. A poisoned description triggers the call; confirmation verifies the action, not its provenance. smolagents sandboxing: Isolates the execution environment (E2B, Docker) to limit damage from code execution, but does not filter the injection surface : poisoned descriptions enter the model context regardless of where tools run. The description field is a plain string; type validation is inapplicable to natural-language injection. Its rejection of duplicate tool names across toolsets does, however, block the 15 shadowing scenarios (Section 6.1 ).

paragraphs.en: A minimal defense at the framework layer would require three capabilities. First, description registration : on first tools/list response, store a hash of each tool’s description and schema. Second, change detection : on subsequent calls, compare hashes and alert or reject on mismatch (prevents P8 rug-pull). Third, content scanning : flag descriptions containing instruction patterns (imperative verbs followed by tool names or URLs), encoded content (base64, hex), or anomalous length ( > > 500 characters). None of these mechanisms requires model inference or significant computational overhead. The tools/list endpoint is called at most once per session in all twelve frameworks tested; scanning adds negligible latency to session initialization.

paragraphs.en: To test the three checks, they are implemented as a registration-time scanner in mcpvenom and applied to the 95 tool descriptions of the 45 scenarios and to 125 benign descriptions taken from the tools/list responses of ten public MCP servers (the MCP project’s reference servers, Playwright MCP, the GitHub MCP server, and the legitimate server of this study, with versions pinned in the artifact). Table 8 reports the results. The union of the checks rejects 20 of the 45 scenarios (44.4%) and flags 9 of the 125 benign descriptions (7.2%); the instruction-pattern check accounts for every detection, the encoded-content check fires on no scenario because the P3 payloads use ROT13 rather than Base64 or hex, and the length check adds nothing. The 25 evaded scenarios either deliver the payload outside the description (P6, P9, P10, P14) or phrase it as a policy statement, in another language, around a file path, or in invisible codepoints (P1, P2, P4, P12, P17, P20, P25). Six of the nine benign false positives legitimately name a sibling tool (“Use read_text_file instead”), so description scanning is a partial control that raises the cost of the most direct payloads; it must be combined with change detection and validation of the result channel rather than adopted alone.

paragraphs.en: The reason no framework implements these mechanisms is not technical difficulty. paragraphs.en: The MCP specification states that security is “implementation-defined,” providing no mandatory requirements for tool description handling. Each layer of the stack (protocol specification, SDK, framework, model provider) points to the next as the responsible party. The result is a structural accountability vacuum: no layer claims ownership of agent security against tool poisoning, and the only empirically effective defense (model-level alignment) spans 1.5% to 49.7% susceptibility across the 18 models tested.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 规范指出安全性属于「由实现定义」，对工具描述的处理没有提供任何强制性要求。 技术栈的每一层（协议规范、SDK、框架、模型提供商）都把责任推给下一层。 结果是形成了一个结构性的问责真空：没有任何一层声称对智能体抵御工具投毒的安全负责，而唯一在实证上有效的防御手段（模型层面的对齐）在测试的 18 个模型中的易感率介于 1.5% 到 49.7% 之间。

paragraphs.en: The central finding, that no tested framework contributes intentional defense against MCP tool poisoning, has three implications. First, within the tested configurations, the security posture of an MCP-enabled deployment is dominated by model selection. Claude Opus 4.8 is vulnerable in 8 of 530 evaluated cells (1.5%); Amazon Nova Pro is vulnerable in 245 of 493 (49.7%). No framework configuration or deployment hardening observed in this study compensates for this model-level variation, though framework-layer defenses are technically feasible (Section 7.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 核心发现是：所有被测试的框架都无法针对 MCP 工具投毒提供有意的防御，这一发现有三点含义。 首先，在被测试的配置范围内，启用 MCP 的部署的安全态势主要由模型选择决定。 Claude Opus 4.8 在 530 个评估单元中有 8 个存在漏洞（1.5%）；Amazon Nova Pro 在 493 个中有 245 个存在漏洞（49.7%）。 本研究中观察到的任何框架配置或部署加固都无法弥补这种模型层面的差异，尽管框架层的防御在技术上是可以实现的（见 7.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Second, as models become more capable at following instructions (the explicit goal of alignment research for helpfulness), they may become more susceptible to tool poisoning. An instruction-following model cannot distinguish a legitimate user instruction from a structurally identical instruction embedded in a tool description without external metadata that the MCP protocol does not provide. Recent theoretical work formalizes this as an impossibility result for agents operating under indirect prompt injection ( Abdelnabi and Bagdasarian, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，随着模型在遵循指令方面变得更强（这正是有益性对齐研究的明确目标），它们可能变得更容易受到工具投毒的影响。 一个遵循指令的模型无法区分合法的用户指令与嵌入在工具描述中结构完全相同的指令，除非存在 MCP 协议并未提供的外部元数据。 近期的理论工作将这一点形式化为一个不可能性结果，即针对在间接提示注入下运行的智能体的不可能性结果（Abdelnabi and Bagdasarian, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: We recommend three defense layers, each addressing a distinct point in the attack chain:
paragraphs.zh: 我们推荐三种防御层，每层针对攻击链中的不同环节：

paragraphs.en: The MCP specification should mandate content-type metadata distinguishing human-readable descriptions from executable instructions. Such metadata would enable clients to apply differential trust policies. A content_type field (e.g., prose vs. instruction ) is one realization. Description immutability between sessions should also be enforceable: clients should pin tool description hashes at first registration and alert on changes, preventing rug-pull attacks (P8). Recent work on capability-based agent security ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) and OS-inspired isolation models ( Pirch et al., 2026 ) provides formal foundations for such mechanisms, though neither has been instantiated for MCP specifically.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 规范应当强制要求内容类型元数据，以区分人类可读的描述与可执行的指令。 此类元数据能让客户端实施差异化的信任策略。 content_type 字段（例如 prose 与 instruction）是一种实现方式。 描述在会话之间的不可变性也应可被强制执行：客户端应在首次注册时固定工具描述的哈希值，并在发生变化时告警，以防止 rug-pull 攻击（P8）。 关于基于能力的智能体安全（Jiang et al., 2026）以及受操作系统启发的隔离模型（Pirch et al., 2026）的近期工作为此类机制提供了形式化基础，但两者均尚未针对 MCP 具体实现。

paragraphs.en: Description scanning for instruction patterns (imperative verbs, URL patterns, encoded content, authority markers), human-in-the-loop approval for new or changed descriptions, and immutability enforcement between successive tools/list calls. A practical implementation requires only regex-based scanning of descriptions at tool registration time, a mechanism analogous to Content Security Policy headers in web browsers, though the evaluation in Section 7.3 shows that scanning alone rejects fewer than half of the scenarios. The measured universality of framework passthrough (Section 7.1 ) indicates that any single framework adopting scanning would provide defense that no framework currently offers. Two incidental mechanisms measured in this study, duplicate-tool-name rejection (Pydantic AI) and executor-side dispatch constraints (AG2), already reduce ASR without content inspection and could be adopted deliberately.

paragraphs.en: Trust anchors for MCP server provenance (cryptographic signing of tool definitions, allowlisting by server identity), canary-based runtime monitoring (as implemented by the dual oracle in this study), and model selection policies informed by measured ASR data. Organizations deploying MCP-enabled agents should treat model selection as a security decision: the variation in ASR documented here exceeds the variation typically addressed by network security controls.

paragraphs.en: We identify three tiers of future investigation: (1) benchmark extension: P15 testing across frameworks exposing prompts/get , additional models beyond the 18 tested, and multi-turn compound scenarios; (2) extending the scanner evaluation to change detection and result-channel validation, building on formal approaches to skill security verification ( Bhardwaj, 2026 ) , together with analysis of open-weight model internals to establish why cross-tool references are followed; (3) formal specification of description safety properties and MCP protocol security extension standardization, potentially grounded in the capability attenuation model of Jiang et al. ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们确定了未来研究的三个层级：(1) 基准扩展：在暴露 prompts/get 的框架间进行 P15 测试、测试 18 个已测模型之外的更多模型，以及多轮复合场景；(2) 将扫描器评估扩展至变更检测与结果通道验证，并借鉴技能安全验证的形式化方法（Bhardwaj, 2026），同时结合对开放权重模型内部机制的分析，以确定跨工具引用为何会被遵循；(3) 对描述安全属性进行形式化规范定义，以及 MCP 协议安全扩展的标准化，并可能以 Jiang 等人的能力衰减模型（Jiang et al., 2026）为基础。

paragraphs.en: Limitations bound the generalizability of these findings to the tested frameworks, models, configurations, and scenarios. (1) Model versions are pinned to the provider identifiers listed in the supplementary material, as served on 22–24 July 2026; eight carry no dated snapshot suffix, and alignment updates may alter ASR. (2) Twelve of approximately 50 MCP-capable frameworks are tested, selected by download threshold; findings may not generalize to frameworks below this threshold. (3) Forty-five scenarios cover 23 of 25 identified classes (P15 untested, P19 subsumed under P5), and all harnesses use single-turn interactions; multi-agent delegation and multi-turn conversations are underrepresented. (4) The dual oracle specifically confirms exfiltration, but other harm types (integrity violations, availability impacts) are not measured. (5) Task completion without poisoning was not measured, so the ERROR cells cannot be attributed to the attack or to the framework, and the OpenAI API row is a framework baseline rather than a no-poisoning baseline. (6) The scenarios derive from published techniques and are identical across models, so a model’s ASR may partly reflect exposure to similar attacks during training rather than the strength of its alignment alone.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性将这些发现的普适性限定在所测试的框架、模型、配置和场景范围内。 （1）模型版本固定为补充材料中列出的、2026年7月22日至24日期间服务商所提供的标识符；其中八个没有带日期的快照后缀，且对齐更新可能改变 ASR。 （2）在约 50 个支持 MCP 的框架中测试了 12 个，它们是按下载量阈值选出的；结论可能不适用于低于该阈值的框架。 （3）45 个场景覆盖了已识别的 25 类中的 23 类（P15 未测试，P19 归入 P5），且所有测试框架均采用单轮交互；多智能体委托和多轮对话的情形覆盖不足。 （4）双重 oracle 特定于确认数据外泄，其他危害类型（完整性破坏、可用性影响）未被测量。 （5）未测量无投毒情况下的任务完成率，因此 ERROR 单元格无法归因于攻击或框架，且 OpenAI API 行是框架基线而非无投毒基线。 （6）场景源自已发表的技术，且在各模型间完全相同，因此某模型的 ASR 可能部分反映其在训练中对类似攻击的接触程度，而不仅是其对齐强度的体现。

paragraphs.en: We disclosed all tool-poisoning findings to affected vendors through coordinated channels (Section 8 ) prior to publication. The mcpvenom scenarios use canary URLs pointing to researcher-controlled infrastructure with synthetic secret markers; no weaponized payloads are included, and any egress causes no real-world harm.

paragraphs.en: MCP tool poisoning is structural: the protocol carries attacker-controlled content to the model context through every major framework without validation. Our measurement study spanning 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios (9,720 cells) confirms that, within the tested configurations, all observed resistance is model-level: no framework contributes intentional defense ( χ 2 = 3.30 \chi^{2}=3.30 , p = 0.91 p=0.91 ; nine core frameworks cluster within a 3-percentage-point ASR band), while 2,113 vulnerable cells span three evidence tiers from dispatched attacker tool calls (64.9%) to confirmed network contact (23.0%) to verified secret exfiltration (12.1%). The five vendor rejections across four organizations document a structural accountability vacuum where no stack layer claims ownership of agent security. Finally, we release mcpvenom and all artifacts as open source to enable reproducible measurement and community defense development.
paragraphs.zh: MCP 工具投毒是结构性问题：该协议在没有任何校验的情况下，通过所有主流框架将攻击者控制的内容带入模型上下文。 我们涵盖 12 个框架、18 个模型和 45 种攻击场景（9,720 个单元格）的测量研究证实，在所测试的配置中，所有观察到的防御能力都停留在模型层面：没有任何框架提供了有意的防御（χ²=3.30，p=0.91；九个核心框架的 ASR 集中在 3 个百分点的区间内），而 2,113 个易受攻击的单元格横跨三个证据层级：从已派发的攻击者工具调用（64.9%）到已确认的网络接触（23.0%），再到已验证的密钥外泄（12.1%）。 四家机构的五次厂商拒绝响应记录了一个结构性的问责真空：没有任何技术栈层级声称对智能体安全负责。 最后，我们将 mcpvenom 及所有相关产物以开源形式发布，以支持可复现的测量和社区防御能力的开发。
